verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents its own built-in capabilities for this: a fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases, a plan agent that analyzes code and suggests changes without modifying files, and automatic LSP loading, which community users praise. The evidence does not show these explaining how components connect or pinpointing where to begin a change, so coverage of the story is partial. Missing for 10: documented architecture or dependency mapping of how the codebase fits together, explicit guidance on locating change entry points, hands-on corroboration of codebase-exploration quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: A fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases. Cannot modify files.
This agent is useful when you want the LLM to analyze code, suggest changes, or create plans without making any actual modifications to your codebase.
LSP enabled Automatically loads the right LSPs for the LLM
